countInvestigation: Strict parsing of the pinned download gives 5574 records, matching UCI metadata and the bundled README's 4827+747 counts. No discrepancy for these exact bytes; differently processed 5572-row copies are not this study's input.
groupReview: Reviewed largest groups and aggregate chain/mixed-label diagnostics before freezing. Largest group is 30/5574 records. Mixed-label or chained components are retained by the algorithm, even though neither occurs in this acquisition.
chronology: No chronological interpretation; the source explicitly says messages are not chronologically sorted.
